name: com.aim4code.nanoserviceflow
description:
A lightweight, Zustand-inspired, zero-dependency state management and event-driven architecture for modern Unity.

Key Features:
▪ True zero-allocation Unidirectional Data Flow
▪ Built-in Dependency Injection & automated Action routing
▪ Custom GC-free ReactiveProperty<T>
▪ Extensible Middleware pipeline for logging and analytics
▪ 100% agnostic async side-effects (Tasks, Coroutines, UniTask)
